usps_evidence: ZIP 11050 primary is Port Washington; Baxter Estates is a name USPS says to avoid. North Hempstead is not a USPS name at all. Not confirmed live.
local_usage_evidence: Part of the Port Washington community: Port Washington water district, Port Washington Police District, Port Washington schools; the town's own directory lists police for 'Port Washington & Baxter Estates'. Residents would say Port Washington; nobody says North Hempstead as a locality.
government_evidence: Real village (incorporated 1931; mayor, deputy mayor, trustees; own .gov site and newsletter). No village police: served by the Port Washington Police District, a special district. One town only. No dissolution found.
reasoning: Conflict: the village name is not what people or the post office use (they say Port Washington), but the town name is used even less. Neither offered option is right; the natural home is the Port Washington community (a CDP). Of the two, own cell is less misleading than a 238k-person town.

usps_evidence: ZIP 11718 primary is Brightwaters, a ZIP of its own distinct from Bay Shore 11706. Not confirmed live.

government_evidence: Real village: mayor and trustees, own code and code enforcement officers, building permits. Police are Suffolk County (general knowledge, not checked). One town. No dissolution found.
reasoning: Own postal name, own government, and the town (Islip, 340k people) is far too coarse; folding would lose a name people use.

usps_evidence: ZIP 10708 primary is Bronxville (Yonkers acceptable; the ZIP also extends into Yonkers and Tuckahoe areas). Not confirmed live.

government_evidence: Real village (incorporated 1898): mayor and trustees, own Bronxville Police Department separate from Eastchester town police. Some functions (dog licences) at Eastchester Town Hall. One town.
reasoning: Distinct name, own ZIP, own police; reporting Eastchester would mislead.

usps_evidence: ZIP 12816 primary is Cambridge. White Creek is not the mailing name. Not confirmed live.

reasoning: Straddles two towns and the population-plurality town (White Creek) is the wrong name: folding would report Cambridge village as White Creek. Must stay its own cell. Note the Town of Cambridge shares the name, so a 'Cambridge NY' string is ambiguous between village and town.

usps_evidence: ZIP 13620 primary is Castorland. Denmark is also a primary name somewhere (its own small post office) but not for these residents. Not confirmed live.

usps_evidence: ZIP 11516 primary is Cedarhurst, no alternatives. Not confirmed live.

usps_evidence: ZIP 13320 primary is Cherry Valley, covering village and town alike. Not confirmed live.

usps_evidence: ZIP 13626 primary is Copenhagen. Not confirmed live.

usps_evidence: ZIP 12832 primary is Granville for village and town alike. Not confirmed live.

usps_evidence: ZIP 10706 primary is Hastings On Hudson (the CSV's 'not a USPS name' is only the hyphen). Greenburgh is a name to avoid. Not confirmed live.

usps_evidence: ZIP 11598 primary is Woodmere; Hewlett Neck is a name USPS says to avoid. Not confirmed live.

usps_evidence: ZIP 12090 primary is Hoosick Falls. Not confirmed live.

usps_evidence: ZIP 10538 primary is Larchmont. Not confirmed live.

government_evidence: Real village: own Larchmont Village Police Department (120 Larchmont Ave), separate from the Town of Mamaroneck police. One town.

usps_evidence: ZIP 13104 primary is Manlius for village and surrounding town. Not confirmed live.

usps_evidence: ZIP 14864 primary is Millport; Veteran is not a USPS name. Not confirmed live.

usps_evidence: ZIP 13409 primary is Munnsville; Stockbridge is a name to avoid. Not confirmed live.

usps_evidence: ZIP 10977 primary is Spring Valley; New Square is acceptable; Ramapo is not a USPS name. Village hall's own address is written 'Spring Valley, NY 10977'. Not confirmed live.

usps_evidence: ZIP 13825 primary is Otego for village and town. Not confirmed live.

usps_evidence: ZIP 14767 primary is Panama; Harmony is not a USPS name. Not confirmed live.

usps_evidence: ZIP 13145 primary is Sandy Creek for 95% of residents and for the town. Not confirmed live.

usps_evidence: ZIP 12866 primary is Saratoga Springs. Not confirmed live.
local_usage_evidence: Well-known city; no ambiguity. (The Town of Saratoga is a different municipality to the east.)
government_evidence: City since 1915, coextensive with the former town of Saratoga Springs and its own county subdivision; commission form of government.

usps_evidence: ZIP 12887 primary is Whitehall for village and town. Not confirmed live.
